```{r}
# 1. 读取 CSV 文件，**关键：在这里指定编码**
# 尝试使用 UTF-8 编码
data <- readr::read_csv(
  "../OUTPUT/result_recovery.csv",
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
)

# 如果 UTF-8 仍然乱码，尝试使用 GBK 或 CP936 (中文 Windows 常见编码)
# data <- readr::read_csv(
#   "../OUTPUT/result_recovery.csv",
# # locale = readr::locale(encoding = "GBK")
# # locale = readr::locale(encoding = "CP936")
# )

# 2. 将数据框转换为 HTML 表格字符串
html_table_string <- knitr::kable(data, format = "html")

# 3. 构建完整的 HTML 页面并保存
html_doc <- htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$head(
    htmltools::tags$meta(charset = "UTF-8"), # 确保 HTML 文件也声明为 UTF-8
    htmltools::tags$title("Recovery"),
    htmltools::tags$style(
      "table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: sans-serif; }",
      "th, td { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 8px; text-align: left; }",
      "th { background-color: #f2f2f2; }"
    )
  ),
  htmltools::tags$body(
    htmltools::tags$h1("Recovery"),
    htmltools::HTML(html_table_string)
  )
)

output_html_path <- "../OUTPUT/result_recovery.html"
htmltools::save_html(html_doc, file = output_html_path)

cat(paste0("CSV 数据已成功保存为 HTML 文件：", output_html_path, "\n"))
```
